notes.exercise_in: Label-value line on the report card directly under 'Jenis Latihan Soal:'; without the colon 'Rincian Soal 2 Digit, 3 Baris, 10 Soal' runs into its value
notes.better_luck_for_next_time: '..' is not Indonesian punctuation; the other languages use the ellipsis '…'
notes.sorry_your_answer_is_incorrect: Shown only on the Report History card (parent area, glossary: reports = parent text); 'jawabanmu' addresses the parent as the one who answered, neutral 'jawabannya' fits parent and child
notes.report_your_answer: Same report row; 'Jawabanmu' (kamu) in a parent report, neutral 'Dijawab:' like fr/es 'Réponse donnée / Respuesta dada', and short for the 12sp row
notes.ob_page2_body: Glossary decision from chunk 01: count (verb) = membilang, berhitung = calculate; here the child counts beads 1, 2, 3
notes.ob_page4_title: 'tambahkan' = add something to; the school verb for adding numbers is 'jumlahkan', matching 'Penjumlahan' in the tour steps
notes.ob_prem_exam: 'operasi' alone reads as surgery / police operation; the fixed school term is 'operasi hitung'
notes.ob_continue_free: 'Lanjutkan' is transitive and needs an object; 'Lanjutkan gratis dulu' is ungrammatical, 'Lanjutkan versi gratis dulu' says continue with the free version for now
